YOLOs are high-risk bets in which a participant commits a large share of funds to a single position. YOLOs are typically described in forums and social media as impulsive decisions taken without regard for downside. YOLOs are used to warn about the possibility of losing most or all of the invested capital.

Margin Call refers to a demand that a trader add collateral when a leveraged position's value falls below the required maintenance level. Margin Call events can lead to forced liquidation of the position if collateral is not topped up. Margin Call warnings in DeFi communities signal the risk of rapid losses from leverage.
